one_line_pitch: A dead-serious heist briefing for stealing one glass of milk at 02:07, every step oddly convenient, one step nearly aborted, until the last slide files the truth in the same flat voice: the guard was awake the whole time, set the job up, and has already put out tomorrow's glass.
narrator_voice: A gravel-voiced planner briefing a crew of one. Clipped declaratives, present tense, second person. Says "the target", "the vault", "the guard", "extraction" without irony. True facts about milk are filed as INTEL, in caps, as if they were floor plans; one fact per slide, never more. The narrator flags an anomaly exactly once with words ("Convenient. Suspicious. Proceed." on the vault) and otherwise uses the refrain "Don't ask." exactly twice (towel, carton), so "Never asked." on the last slide lands as an echo and not a tell. No exclamation marks anywhere in the artwork. No soft adjective, no cute noun, no emoji, no "you were never here". On the final slide the register does not change at all; the reveal is reported as a status update ("Guard: awake. Confirmed.") and the closing headline is a statistic. Hard rule for every slide: 25 words on canvas, counting headline, body, INTEL and labels.

palette.name: Fridge Dark
palette.use: Background of slides 1 to 8. The kitchen at 2 a.m. Never pure black, so the wedge has something to glow against.

palette.name: Bulb
palette.use: The fridge-light wedge, the straw, the GO dot, the witness eyes, the hook sub-line 'without waking the guard.', and the entire ground of slide 9. The only warmth on screen.

palette.name: Milk
palette.use: All headline and body type on dark slides, the glass, the pour, the carton body, the towel, the blanket. Reserved: nothing else is this light, so the eye finds the milk first.

palette.name: Duvet Blue
palette.use: Silhouettes, shelves, counter, sink, fridge body, floorboards, the carton's label panel, the doorway frame, the stool. On slide 9 it becomes the type and figure colour on Bulb.

palette.name: Alarm
palette.use: Target circles, the CREAK hairline, the FREEZE word, the 02:13 timestamp, the TOWEL — GONE circle, the SEND line. Used small and rationed so the full-size FREEZE on slide 7 is the only time it goes big.

palette.name: Ghost Light
palette.use: All INTEL notes, map labels and leader lines. Roughly 7:1 on Fridge Dark; legible on a dim phone. This tier carries the actual milk knowledge, so it must be readable.

palette.name: Ghost
palette.use: Chrome only: outlined step numerals, persisted route lines from earlier slides, dimmed items on the top shelf, header file number, slide counter. Never used for anything the reader needs to read.

typography.display_font: Anton (Google Fonts; fallback Impact, 'Arial Narrow Bold', sans-serif)
typography.body_font: IBM Plex Mono (Google Fonts; fallback 'Courier New', monospace)
typography.notes: Anton because it is the tallest, tightest all-caps face on Google Fonts that still renders cleanly at 210 px on a 1080 canvas and reads as dossier, not poster. Step headlines: Anton, Milk, two lines ('STEP 3.' at 96 px on line one, the step name at 190 px on line two, line-height 0.88, letter-spacing -0.01em), ending by y 460. Hook headline: 'HOW TO' / 'DRINK' / 'MILK' at 210 px, three lines, RIGHT-aligned to x 1008 so the K of MILK sits inside the wedge; sub-line 'without waking' / 'the guard.' in Anton lowercase, Bulb, 110 px, two lines, right-aligned. Close headline: '1,204 JOBS.' / '0 ARRESTS.' in Anton, Duvet Blue, 170 px, two lines. Body: IBM Plex Mono Regular, Milk, 44 px, line-height 1.35, HARD RULES: maximum 3 lines, maximum 30 characters per line, one beat per line (short sentences may share a line), 13 words maximum. Three lines bottom-anchored at baseline y 1180 top out at y 1010, so the body can never touch the illustration band (y 470 to 1000). INTEL: IBM Plex Mono Medium, 36 px, all caps, letter-spacing 0.06em, Ghost Light; maximum 2 lines of 34 characters, one fact per slide, 10 words maximum. Map labels: same style as INTEL, maximum 2 labels per slide, attached by a 2 px Ghost Light leader ending in a 6 px dot. Timestamp: IBM Plex Mono Medium, 72 px, Milk, styled like a lock-screen clock. Header file number and slide counter: IBM Plex Mono, 26 px, Ghost (chrome, not content). Step numerals: Anton, 900 px, transparent fill, -webkit-text-stroke 2px Ghost at 55 percent opacity, behind everything. Redaction bar on slide 9: an inline-block span of Duvet Blue, 8 characters wide, mono cap height.

design_system.illustration_style: Flat two-tone silhouette vector built only from CSS boxes, border-radius, clip-path polygons and short inline SVG paths. Rectangles for fridge, counter and sink; the carton is a Milk rounded rect with a triangular gable and a Duvet Blue label panel on its face (the panel is the window through which the milk level is drawn, so a Milk fill is never invisible against a Milk carton); a trapezoid for the glass; a Bulb path with a three-segment zigzag elbow for the bendy straw; a Duvet Blue rectangle outline 360 by 520 for a doorway (planted on slide 6, paid off on slide 9); a small Duvet Blue step stool (a 90 by 24 top with two splayed legs) planted as a Ghost outline on slide 5 and drawn solid on slide 9. Everything lives in Duvet Blue on Fridge Dark except what the light wedge touches: inside the wedge, duplicated shapes flip to Milk and Bulb, clipped by the same polygon as the wedge. Heist-map language on every slide: SVG dashed lines (stroke-dasharray 14 10) for routes, Alarm circles (stroke 4 px, no fill) for targets, mono labels with a thin leader line ending in a 6 px dot. No faces, no hands, no hair. The crew is never drawn; its size is stated only by objects (towel on the board, carton moved down, REACH 0.96 m, two hands, bendy straw, stool) until slide 9 gives it an adult to stand next to.
design_system.recurring_motif: The wedge of fridge light. A clip-path trapezoid anchored to the right edge with the hinge implied off-canvas: polygon(calc(100% - W) 100%, 100% 100%, 100% 0, calc(100% - W/2) 0), so at any height the light is at least half its bottom width and actually reaches the things it is said to touch. Filled with linear-gradient(250deg, #FFD43B 0%, rgba(255,212,59,0.55) 45%, transparent 100%). W grows every slide as the door opens and the timestamp ticks with it, two clocks running: S1 W 200 (02:06), S2 300 (02:07, the GO dot sits inside it), S3 400 (02:09), S4 500 (02:10, the wedge is the crack between vault door and body), S5 620 (02:11), S6 740 (02:12), S7 820 (02:13, timestamp in Alarm), S8 snaps back to a 90 px sliver (02:15, the door pushed shut), S9 floods the full canvas (02:16) and the palette inverts: Bulb ground, Duvet Blue shapes and type. Second accumulating motif: the route. A fixed base path drawn on slide 3 (in from the hallway door at the bottom of the floor plan, up the boards, over the towel, out toward the fridge at top-right) persists at the same canvas position in Ghost at 40 percent on every later slide, confined to the illustration band so it never sits under body text; each slide adds one terminal segment (to the vault, to the counter, to the sink, back out). On slide 9 the whole path is redrawn dashed in Duvet Blue: the guard's own diagram of the job.
design_system.layout_rules: Canvas 1080 by 1350. Safe margins 72 px left and right, 96 px top and bottom. Header band y 96 to 200: bottom-left 'MILK RUN // FILE 0902' in 26 px mono Ghost; right-aligned timestamp at 72 px; a 2 px dashed SVG rule (dasharray 18 12, Ghost) at y 200 on slides 2 to 8 only, no rule on the two bookend slides. Headline block y 250 to 460 on step slides, left-aligned at x 72 (x 200 on slide 7 to clear the FREEZE column), max width 936. Illustration band y 470 to 1000. Body block bottom-anchored, last baseline y 1180, left-aligned at x 72 (x 200 on slide 7), max width 800, max 3 lines, so its top is never above y 1010. INTEL and labels live inside the illustration band, attached to what they describe, never in the body block; at most one INTEL and two labels per slide; 25 words total per slide. Slide counter bottom-right at y 1254 in 26 px mono Ghost ('01 / 09'). The 900 px outlined numeral is right-aligned to x 1008, vertically centred at y 720, behind every layer, on slides 2 to 8 only. Persisted Ghost route is clipped to y 470 to 1000. Nothing important inside the outer 40 px on any side.
design_system.typography_check: Every body line was checked at 44 px mono (26.4 px per character, 30 characters in 800 px) and every INTEL line at 36 px (21.6 px per character, 34 characters in 734 px).

slides.headline: HOW TO DRINK MILK without waking the guard.
slides.visual_direction: Full-bleed Fridge Dark. The light wedge enters from the right edge, 200 px wide along the bottom and 100 px wide at the top (trapezoid, hinge implied off-canvas), Bulb at full strength on its outer edge; on a phone at 30 percent brightness it reads as a fridge door open one finger's width. Headline 'HOW TO' / 'DRINK' / 'MILK' in Anton, Milk, 210 px, three lines, RIGHT-aligned to x 1008, so the K of MILK sits inside the light (the wedge is roughly 150 px wide at the height of MILK; the word spans x 590 to 1008). Directly beneath, right-aligned, in Anton lowercase, Bulb, 110 px, two lines: 'without waking' / 'the guard.' It is the joke and it is the second-largest thing on the slide, in the one warm colour, tied to the light. No body block; the slide is the headline, the sub-line, and one map marker. Bottom-left: a 72 px Alarm circle (stroke 4 px, no fill) with the mono label 'GUARD: DOWN. UNCONFIRMED.' in Ghost Light to its right, and a dashed Ghost Light leader running from the circle off the left edge of the canvas, as though the map continues beyond the frame. No dashed header rule and no numeral on this slide.
slides.layout_notes: Header band: 'MILK RUN // FILE 0902' bottom-left, 02:06 top-right, no rule. Headline y 250 to 805, right edge at x 1008. Sub-line y 830 to 1040, right edge at x 1008. GUARD marker centred at x 140, y 1130; label at 36 px from x 200, baseline y 1142; leader exits the left edge at y 1130. Counter '01 / 09' bottom-right. Dominant element: MILK inside the light, then the Bulb sub-line. On-canvas words: 10.
slides.alt_text: A near-black slide with a bright yellow wedge of fridge light along the right edge. Huge white block letters, right-aligned, read HOW TO DRINK MILK, the K of MILK inside the light, and beneath them in yellow lowercase letters: without waking the guard. In the bottom-left corner a red circle is labelled GUARD: DOWN. UNCONFIRMED., with a dashed line running off the edge of the slide. The clock reads 02:06.

slides.headline: STEP 1. THE WINDOW.
slides.body:
Guard went down at 22:40.
You move at 02:07.
Not a minute before.
slides.small_text: GUARD — COUCH. NOT BED. NOTED.   //   GO   //   22:40   //   02:07
slides.visual_direction: The couch is the picture. A large Duvet Blue silhouette filling the left 55 percent of the illustration band: three overlapping rounded rectangles for the couch and the sleeping body, one circle for the head at the left arm, one flat Milk rectangle for the blanket, no features. An Alarm circle (stroke 4 px, 160 px) around the head. Beneath the couch, the label 'GUARD — COUCH. NOT BED. NOTED.' in Ghost Light with a leader to the circle: the plant that pays off on slides 6 and 9. Below the illustration, a timeline drawn as a caption: a 3 px Milk line from x 72 to x 1008 with only two ticks, '22:40' under the couch end (an Alarm dot on the line) and '02:07' at the far right where a 24 px Bulb dot with an 80 px radial Bulb halo is labelled 'GO'. The wedge is 300 px wide, so the GO dot sits fully inside the light: the go time is the first thing lit. Giant outlined numeral '1' behind everything.
slides.layout_notes: Headline 'STEP 1.' / 'THE WINDOW.' top-left, through y 460. Couch x 72 to 620, y 520 to 780; head circle centred at x 150, y 600. Label under the couch at x 72, baseline y 840 (30 characters, 648 px). Timeline at y 930; '22:40' tick at x 200 with the numeral beneath at y 980; GO dot at x 960, y 930, with 'GO' above it at y 880. Body block baseline y 1180, three lines. Timestamp 02:07. Counter '02 / 09'. On-canvas words: 23.
slides.alt_text: A dark slide dominated by a blue silhouette of someone asleep on a couch, a pale blanket over them, their head circled in red. A label beneath reads GUARD, COUCH, NOT BED, NOTED. Under the couch a thin timeline has two marks: 22:40 at the left and 02:07 at the right, where a glowing yellow dot labelled GO sits inside a wedge of fridge light. Text: Guard went down at 22:40. You move at 02:07. Not a minute before. Headline: STEP 1. THE WINDOW.

slides.headline: STEP 2. THE FLOOR.
slides.body:
Third board creaks.
Someone laid a towel over it.
Don't ask.
slides.small_text: CREAK   //   TOWEL — ORIGIN UNKNOWN.   //   SOCKS. NOT SLIPPERS. SLIPPERS SLAP.
slides.visual_direction: Top-down floor plan of the hallway filling the illustration band: eight vertical Duvet Blue stripes, 96 px wide with 16 px Fridge Dark gaps, from y 470 to y 1000. The third board from the left carries a 6 px Alarm hairline down its centre with the label 'CREAK' set vertically beside it in Alarm; the board itself stays Duvet Blue so the full-red moment is saved for slide 7. Draped across the third board at rotate(-4deg): a Milk rounded rectangle 300 by 150 px with an inline SVG pattern of thin diagonal Ghost lines, the towel, labelled 'TOWEL — ORIGIN UNKNOWN.' with a leader. The base route: a dashed Milk line (stroke 4 px, dasharray 14 10) starts at a small Milk door symbol (quarter-circle arc plus a line) at the bottom of the plan, runs up the hallway, hops the towel with a small arc, and exits the top of the plan toward the right where the wedge is. This exact path is redrawn in Ghost at 40 percent, clipped to the band, on every later slide. The SOCKS note sits at the bottom-right of the plan in Ghost Light, two lines, with a leader to the route. Outlined numeral '2' behind. Wedge 400 px wide, now reaching the top of the plan.
slides.layout_notes: Headline top-left through y 460. Floor plan x 72 to 968, y 470 to 1000. Door symbol at x 160, y 990; route from there up to the towel, over it, exiting at x 900, y 470. Towel centred at x 320, y 700. CREAK label reads top to bottom beside the hairline at x 300. SOCKS note at x 620 to 1000, y 900 to 980: 'SOCKS. NOT SLIPPERS.' / 'SLIPPERS SLAP.' Body block baseline y 1180. Timestamp 02:09. Counter '03 / 09'. On-canvas words: 22.
slides.alt_text: A top-down floor plan of a hallway drawn as eight blue floorboards. A thin red line runs down the third board, labelled CREAK. A white striped towel lies across it, labelled TOWEL, ORIGIN UNKNOWN. A dashed white route starts at a small door symbol at the bottom, runs up the hall, hops the towel, and exits toward a wedge of yellow light. A note reads SOCKS. NOT SLIPPERS. SLIPPERS SLAP. Text: Third board creaks. Someone laid a towel over it. Don't ask. Headline: STEP 2. THE FLOOR.

slides.headline: STEP 3. THE VAULT.
slides.body:
Door open a crack.
Light already on.
slides.small_text: Convenient. Suspicious. Proceed.   //   INTEL — DOOR SHELF IS THE WARMEST SEAT. NOTHING WORTH TAKING LIVES THERE.
slides.visual_direction: The fridge as a bank vault. A Duvet Blue rounded rectangle 480 by 440 px on the right of the illustration band is the vault body. Its door is a second rounded rectangle of the same size with transform-origin right center and transform: perspective(1400px) rotateY(-28deg), so it stands genuinely ajar, foreshortened, and the 80 px strip between door edge and body fills with Bulb: that strip is this slide's wedge, spilling down and left across the floor as a trapezoid of Bulb gradient. On the door: a circular SVG dial handle, 140 px, twelve tick marks, a Milk pointer. Inside the crack, three thin Milk shelf lines. On the inner face of the door, one shelf in Milk outline is tagged with a small Alarm circle; the INTEL note about the door shelf sits above the vault, two lines, leader down to that shelf. On the floor inside the spilled light, stacked in IBM Plex Mono 40 px Milk, the only wink in words on the whole run: 'Convenient.' / 'Suspicious.' / 'Proceed.' The Ghost route from slide 3 persists faintly and gains a terminal segment ending at the vault door. Outlined numeral '3' behind. Effective wedge width 500 px.
slides.layout_notes: Headline top-left through y 460. INTEL at x 72 to 810, y 480 to 550: 'DOOR SHELF IS THE WARMEST SEAT.' / 'NOTHING WORTH TAKING LIVES THERE.' Vault body x 520 to 1000, y 560 to 1000; door hinged on the right, gap opening toward the centre-left. Dial centred at x 720, y 780. Floor light trapezoid from the door foot at x 520, y 1000 leftward to x 160. Stacked words at x 200 to 500, y 850 to 990. Body block baseline y 1180, two lines. Timestamp 02:10. Counter '04 / 09'. On-canvas words: 23.
slides.alt_text: A refrigerator drawn as a bank vault: a blue box with a round dial handle, its door angled open so a strip of yellow light spills across the floor. In the light, three monospace words are stacked: Convenient. Suspicious. Proceed. A note above says the door shelf is the warmest seat and nothing worth taking lives there. Text: Door open a crack. Light already on. Headline: STEP 3. THE VAULT.

slides.headline: STEP 4. THE TARGET.
slides.body:
Bottom shelf, back.
Small carton. Moved down.
Glass already out. Don't ask.
slides.small_text: REACH — 0.96 m   //   INTEL — COLDEST SHELF. ONE POUR. NEVER FROM THE CARTON.
slides.visual_direction: The target and the vessel in one frame. Right two-thirds of the illustration band: the fridge interior straight on, a Duvet Blue frame with three horizontal Milk-outline shelves. Top shelf: two tall bottles and one large carton in Ghost outline, dimmed. Middle shelf: three low containers in Ghost. Bottom shelf, back-right: one small carton 120 by 190 px, Milk body, gable top, Duvet Blue label panel, fully lit, inside an Alarm target circle (stroke 4 px, 240 px). No TARGET label; the circle is the label. A dashed Bulb arrow arcs from a Ghost outline of the same small carton on the top shelf down to its new position, unlabelled; the body says 'Moved down' and that is all the comment it gets. A horizontal dashed Alarm line at the carton's height runs across the inside of the fridge from the left wall to the carton, the label 'REACH — 0.96 m' above it. The INTEL note sits under the bottom shelf inside the frame, two lines. Left third of the band, foreground: a short Duvet Blue counter slab with a trapezoid Milk glass on it, empty, a Bulb bendy straw already leaning out of it, unlabelled and unremarked; the drawing says it. At the foot of the counter, a Ghost outline of a small step stool, unlabelled, the plant nobody notices until slide 9. Ghost route persists with a terminal segment ending at the counter. Outlined numeral '4' behind. Wedge 620 px wide, so the whole fridge interior is inside the light.
slides.layout_notes: Headline top-left through y 460. Fridge frame x 420 to 1000, y 470 to 1000; shelves at y 560, 720, 880. Target carton centred at x 860, bottom on the shelf at y 880; Ghost carton on the top shelf at x 860, y 500. REACH line at y 800 from x 440 to x 790, label at x 440, baseline y 780. INTEL at x 440 to 990, y 910 to 980: 'COLDEST SHELF. ONE POUR.' / 'NEVER FROM THE CARTON.' Counter slab x 72 to 360, y 860 to 900; glass centred at x 200, y 700 to 860; straw leaning right. Stool outline x 150 to 240, y 940 to 1000. Body block baseline y 1180, three lines. Timestamp 02:11. Counter '05 / 09'. On-canvas words: 25.
slides.alt_text: The inside of a refrigerator drawn in blue outlines, with ghosted bottles on the top shelf. On the bottom shelf a small white milk carton glows inside a red target circle; a dashed arrow shows it was moved down from the top shelf. A red dashed line at the carton's height is labelled REACH 0.96 m. A note says coldest shelf, one pour, never from the carton. On a counter at the left an empty glass waits with a bendy straw already in it, and a faint outline of a step stool sits beneath. Text: Bottom shelf, back. Small carton. Moved down. Glass already out. Don't ask. Headline: STEP 4. THE TARGET.

slides.headline: STEP 5. ABORT.
slides.body:
Couch is empty. Blanket down.
Thirty seconds. Nothing.
Proceed.
slides.visual_direction: The stakes slide. The crew looks back. Centre-right of the illustration band: a Duvet Blue doorway frame, 360 by 520, outline 16 px, the kitchen doorway (it returns on slide 9 with someone in it). Inside the frame the wedge is masked out with a Fridge Dark rectangle: the living room is unlit. Through the door, the couch from slide 2 redrawn small in Duvet Blue, the head circle gone, the Milk blanket slumped on the floor in front of it as a crumpled polygon. An Alarm circle (stroke 4 px, 200 px) around the empty cushion, and the label 'GUARD — NOT HERE.' in Ghost Light on the kitchen side of the frame with a leader through the doorway to the circle. Nothing else. The slide is deliberately the sparest in the run: the headline says ABORT, the body counts to thirty and reverses it. This is the misdirect that makes the creak in the hall on the next slide land. Ghost route persists, no new segment. Outlined numeral '5' behind. Wedge 740 px wide, lighting the kitchen side of the frame; the darkness inside the door is the composition.
slides.layout_notes: Headline 'STEP 5.' / 'ABORT.' top-left through y 460. Doorway frame x 560 to 920, y 480 to 1000. Couch inside at x 600 to 880, y 800 to 900; blanket polygon at x 640 to 800, y 900 to 960. Alarm circle centred at x 740, y 780. Label at x 72, baseline y 700 with the leader running right to the circle. Body block baseline y 1180, three lines. Timestamp 02:12. Counter '06 / 09'. On-canvas words: 14.
slides.alt_text: A dark kitchen with a tall blue doorway frame. Through the doorway, in darkness, the couch from earlier is empty and a pale blanket lies crumpled on the floor. A red circle around the empty cushion is labelled GUARD, NOT HERE. Text: Couch is empty. Blanket down. Thirty seconds. Nothing. Proceed. Headline: STEP 5. ABORT. The clock reads 02:12.

slides.headline: STEP 6. THE POUR.
slides.body:
Two hands. Slow.
Creak in the hall. Not yours.
Freeze. Wait. Pour.
slides.small_text: FREEZE.   //   SET OF FOUR. THE LAST ONE.
slides.visual_direction: Tension peak, diagonal composition, one dominant: FREEZE. Down the left margin, rotated 90 degrees reading top to bottom, the single word 'FREEZE.' in Anton, Alarm, 190 px, the only time Alarm goes big. Behind it, two concentric Alarm rings (stroke 3 px, radii 200 and 320) centred off-canvas at the left edge, radiating into the frame: the creak in the hall, unlabelled, the body names it. The small carton from slide 5, now 260 px tall, sits upper-left of centre tilted 40 degrees: Milk body, gable top, Duvet Blue label panel on its face, and inside that panel the milk level is drawn as an unrotated Milk rectangle clipped to the panel, so the surface stays perfectly level while the carton tips. From its spout a tapered SVG path in Milk falls in a gentle curve to the glass at bottom-right, one-third full, surface a flat Milk line, Bulb straw leaning out. Upper-right, a two-line label in Ghost Light with a leader to the glass rim: 'SET OF FOUR.' / 'THE LAST ONE.' The stakes of the pour, in six words, no INTEL on this slide. Timestamp flips to Alarm and reads 02:13, a single clean copy, no flicker. Outlined numeral '6' stays Ghost. Ghost route persists faintly at the bottom-left, behind the rings. Wedge 820 px wide.
slides.layout_notes: Headline top-left starting at x 200 on this slide only, through y 460. FREEZE column x 72 to 180, y 480 to 1100. Rings centred at x -40, y 760. Carton centred at x 440, y 640 (top edge stays below y 470 after rotation). Pour path from x 520, y 720 to x 760, y 900. Glass centred at x 780, y 800 to 1000. Glass label at x 720 to 1008, y 500 to 570, leader to the rim. Body block at x 200, baseline y 1180, three lines. Timestamp 02:13 in Alarm. Counter '07 / 09'. On-canvas words: 21.
slides.alt_text: A tilted white milk carton with a dark label panel pours a curving white stream into a glass with a bendy straw. The word FREEZE runs down the left margin in tall red letters, with two red rings radiating from the edge behind it. A label by the glass reads SET OF FOUR. THE LAST ONE. The corner clock has turned red and reads 02:13. Text: Two hands. Slow. Creak in the hall. Not yours. Freeze. Wait. Pour. Headline: STEP 6. THE POUR.

slides.headline: STEP 7. EXTRACTION.
slides.body:
Drink standing. Rinse cold.
Hot water sets the protein.
A film is a confession.
slides.small_text: WITNESS: 1. NOT A THREAT.   //   TOWEL — GONE.
slides.visual_direction: Almost entirely dark again; the wedge has snapped back to a 90 px sliver on the right edge, the door pushed shut. The one bright thing: in the upper-left dark, two 24 px Bulb dots 48 px apart with 80 px radial halos, at cat-eye height, labelled 'WITNESS: 1. NOT A THREAT.' on a leader; no other part of the animal is drawn. Below them, a Duvet Blue sink basin (rounded rect 520 by 180 with a Milk edge line and a small Milk tap arc above it) at the bottom of the band, the empty glass on its side inside it in thin Milk outline, straw leaning out over the rim, one Milk drop below the tap. The rinse fact is promoted into the body this time, because it is the one thing most people do not know and it deserves 44 px. A dashed Milk route retreats from the sink toward the bottom-left of the band, retracing the base path, and stops at an Alarm circle (stroke 4 px, 120 px) drawn around nothing, exactly where the towel sat on slide 3, with the label 'TOWEL — GONE.' in Alarm. Somebody picked it up. The slide ends open, not closed. All earlier Ghost route segments visible at 40 percent, so the floor plan of the whole job reads faintly under the sink. Outlined numeral '7' behind. No JOB COMPLETE; the job is not.
slides.layout_notes: Headline top-left through y 460. Witness dots at x 200 and 248, y 540; label from x 300, baseline y 552. Sink x 360 to 880, y 820 to 1000; tap at x 620, y 740. Retreat route from x 500, y 1000 down-left to the circle centred at x 160, y 940. TOWEL — GONE label at x 72, baseline y 850 (13 characters). Body block baseline y 1180, three lines. Timestamp 02:15 in Milk. Counter '08 / 09'. On-canvas words: 23.
slides.alt_text: A dark kitchen. Two small yellow dots glow in the upper-left dark, labelled WITNESS: 1. NOT A THREAT. Below, a blue sink holds an empty glass on its side with a bendy straw sticking out, drawn in thin white outline. A dashed route retreats from the sink to a red circle around empty floor, labelled TOWEL, GONE. The fridge light is a thin sliver. Text: Drink standing. Rinse cold. Hot water sets the protein. A film is a confession. Headline: STEP 7. EXTRACTION.

slides.headline: 1,204 JOBS. 0 ARRESTS.
slides.body:
Guard: awake. Confirmed.
Towel. Carton. Stool.
Never asked.
slides.small_text: GLASS 2 — TOMORROW.   //   SUSPECT: ▮▮▮▮▮▮▮▮   //   SEND THIS TO WHOEVER PUT THE GLASS OUT.
slides.visual_direction: The reveal, filed in the same voice. The fridge door is fully open and the wedge floods the entire canvas: the ground is Bulb, every shape and every letter is Duvet Blue, the palette inverted for the first time. The headline is the statistic, in Anton, Duvet Blue, 170 px, two lines: '1,204 JOBS.' / '0 ARRESTS.' The body reports the status in the register of slide 1's marker ('Guard: awake. Confirmed.'), inventories the evidence in four nouns instead of a recap, and ends on the echo of the refrain. The kitchen is stripped to what matters. A Duvet Blue counter slab across the lower band (a thick bar with a leg at each end, no front face), and beneath it, pushed against it on the floor, a solid Duvet Blue step stool, the Ghost outline from slide 5 now real. Standing on the counter directly above the stool: a second clean glass in Duvet Blue outline, straw already in it, inside a small Alarm circle, the only circled object on the slide, with the two-line label 'GLASS 2 —' / 'TOMORROW.' to its left and 80 px of clear Bulb all round. Far right: the doorway frame from slide 6, and in it a tall adult silhouette built from rounded shapes, long torso, one arm folded across, head tilted slightly, feet on the floor line; the counter top meets the figure at hip height and the stool reads instantly as what a small person needs to reach the same counter. The full route from slide 3, dashed Duvet Blue, runs from the doorway to the fridge position at the right edge, to the counter, to where the sink was: the guard's own diagram. Bottom-left, the share line as an evidence tag: a Duvet Blue-outlined rectangle, line one 'SUSPECT:' followed by a solid Duvet Blue redaction bar, line two in Alarm mono 'SEND THIS TO WHOEVER PUT THE GLASS OUT.', with a dashed Alarm leader from the tag to the figure in the doorway. No numeral, no dashed header rule, no save icon: the caption carries the save. Timestamp 02:16 in Duvet Blue.
